Revise the following.

## Quadratics

1. Solve quadratic equations by factorising
2. Solve linear equalities and inequalities
3. Solve simultaneous linear equations
4. Carry out simple manipulation of surds

## Coordinate Geometry

1. Find the midpoint and length of a line segment
2. Find the gradient (slope) of a line and state the gradient of a ine that is perpendicular to the line
3. Interpret and use equations of lines of the form y = mx + c

## Circular Measure

1. Find the perimeter and area of sectors
2. Use Pythagoras’ theorem and trigonometry on right-angled triangles.

## Series

1. Arithmetic and Geometric progressions
2. Calculating the nth term
